description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans-based Silo cluster, specifically testing the behavior of the consistent ring provider during silo failures and joins. It defines a test class with multiple test scenarios, helper methods for simulating failures and joins, and verification routines.

classes.name: ConsistentRingProviderTests_Silo
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the Orleans consistent ring provider's behavior in different failure and join scenarios.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: Helper class implementing silo and client configurators for the test cluster setup.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with silo and client settings.

methods.name: FailureTest
methods.description: Simulates silo failures and verifies cluster stability and key consistency.

methods.name: JoinTest
methods.description: Tests joining additional silos to the cluster and verifies the ring stability.

methods.name: PickKey
methods.description: Selects a key responsible for a specific silo for testing the ring assignment.

methods.name: VerificationScenario
methods.description: Verifies key assignments across silos for correctness.

methods.name: VerifyKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key maps to the expected silo across cluster members.

methods.name: getSilosToFail
methods.description: Determines which silos to fail based on fail code for testing fail scenarios.

methods.name: printSilos
methods.description: Outputs the list of silos, primarily for debugging purposes.

methods.name: AssertEventually
methods.description: Retries assertions until success or timeout, useful for eventual consistency tests.
